verdict.rationale: ESD's own unemployment-tax page says employers can "see the current tax rates and learn how we set them" (wa-esd-docs-4), so rate information is self-published rather than behind a contact form. However, no actual rate figures or penalty amounts appear in the evidence, and penalties are only mentioned without amounts (wa-esd-docs-2). Missing for 10: actual published rate figures, specific penalty/late-fee amounts, transaction-specific fee schedule, independent corroboration.
